Just to clarify, Dr. Wu is the one who corrected the crooked implant I had done at another clinic in Bang Na.

The clinic that did it wrong also has a professor of medicine (the doctor had students subtly asking questions throughout the procedure).
We contacted the doctor, and they said it wasn't crooked. I was in excruciating pain, level 8. Paracetamol didn't help.
Ibuprofen didn't help. Ponstan didn't help.
Imagine the agony from leaving the old clinic at 12:00 PM until I was in Dr. Wu's clinic at 7:00 PM.

Dr. Wu's clinic wasn't open today, but he said he couldn't sleep after seeing the X-rays.
He kindly opened the clinic for me, accompanied by his assistant.

Dr. Wu removed the pus sac that the old clinic hadn't completely removed, causing constant pain.

He also inserted collagen and bone grafts.

Now the implant is perfectly straight.
I want to commend Dr. Wu.

He was meticulous and attentive in every detail.
He had 3 CT scans and 2 3D scans.
The treatment cost 300 baht.
And I haven't experienced any pain since the treatment!

The dentist spent 3 hours fixing my dental work, and even when I offered to pay extra, they refused, saying they just wanted to do it for me.

I don't know how to thank them enough.
I want to spread the word that there are still incredibly skilled and honest dentists out there!
I've never met such a good person before.

If you're considering a dental clinic, check out BKK 48 Dental Clinic.

You won't be disappointed with the price or quality. Guaranteed affordable.
